headline: Mobile App Development Cost: 3 Worked Examples With Real Numbers (2026)
description: What does a mobile app cost to build? Three worked examples, an MVP, a market-ready app and an AI-powered platform, with weeks, budget ranges and where to save.

itemListElement.name: Mobile App Development Cost: 3 Worked Examples With Real Numbers (2026)

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a mobile app in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on scope. Using our method, a lean MVP is about 7 weeks and roughly $2.5k to $4k, a market-ready product is about 25 weeks and roughly $9k to $15k, and an AI-powered platform is about 48 weeks and roughly $17.5k to $29k. These are indicative ranges, confirmed by a discovery call.

mainEntity.name: What makes one app cost more than another?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stage, the number of expensive features (payments, chat, maps, AI, offline), backend complexity, the number of platforms and design depth. Features that touch money or real-time data cost the most.

mainEntity.name: Can I reduce the cost without lowering quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Build a true MVP, keep the backend managed at first, buy commodity capabilities instead of building them, and ship on one shared codebase for iOS and Android.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build each type of app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Roughly 7 weeks for the MVP example, 25 for the market-ready example and 48 for the AI platform example, using the same method. See how long it takes to build an app for timelines in more detail.
